title: Deep learning predicts IDH1 mutation status in acute myeloid leukemia from bone marrow smears.
summary: Attention-based multiple-instance learning predicts IDH1 mutation from bone-marrow smears in 436 AML patients across four centers with pooled ROC-AUC 0.81 and a clinically specific retrospective evaluation. Published in npj Precision Oncology.
